rationale: Any behavior marked as 'Severe' poses a liability risk. The technician must formally acknowledge that an Incident Report was filed before the software will allow them to save the behavior data.

citation: Agency SOP: Scope of Competence for Technicians
rationale: RBTs/Technicians are not authorized to provide formal parent coaching, review IEP goals, or alter generalization strategies. A BCBA must be present in the session for these high-level clinical handoff tasks to be validly logged.

citation: Agency SOP: Mandatory In-Home Caregiver Engagement
rationale: To maintain funding and comply with agency standards, all in-home sessions must conclude with active caregiver engagement. The technician cannot leave the handoff blank or select 'Caregiver unavailable' at the end of a home session.
